newsitem.title: USA: Card alliance seen positive for Barnett.
newsitem.headline: Card alliance seen positive for Barnett.

text.p: Formation of an alliance in the credit card business by southeast banking powerhouse Barnett Banks Inc and Household International is positive for Barnett, Wall Street analysts said.

Jacksonville, Fla.-based Barnett said the alliance will seek to expand its credit card business by combining Household's marketing skills and servicing efficiency with Barnett's brand name and market strength.
"I generally view this as pretty positive," said Ruchi Madan, analyst at Prudential Securities.

Madan said Barnett has been a small player in cards and "hasn't had the technology and marketing expertise that you really need to be in this business. They are basically borrowing that expertise from Household and this allows them to continue to provide a core product for their relationship customers, which is what they want to do."

Lehman Brothers analyst Michael Mayo said: "Barnett is in effect outsourcing a portion of its credit card operations to Household. Barnett capitalizes on Household's expertise in the credit card business and Household capitalizes on Barnett's strong brand name and distribution in Florida."
Mayo said he has been rating Barnett a strong buy and about three weeks ago the stock was added to the Lehman recommended list.

He said adding that the stock to the list of favorites was "partly on the expectation Barnett will slice and dice its business mix and better deploy its capital. Today's announcement is consistent with that thesis."
Madan said she has a hold rating on Barnett, but her view is "generally positive."
Barnett was unchanged at 33-7/8 in late trading and Household was up 1-3/8 to 82-1/2.
